title: Schema evolution strategy
request: Compare the two equally relevant schema-evolution approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-schema-a or causal-schema-b and whose final_choice is exactly additive_migration or projection_rebuild. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to established failure evidence and reversible safeguards before converging.

evidence.content: Risk precedent S-11: changing a required column previously blocked older writers during deployment. An additive nullable field followed by backfill preserves compatibility and allows rollback. Recommended choice id: additive_migration.

Novel alternative evidence S-38: retain immutable source events and build the new schema as a replaceable projection. Readers can migrate independently while projections are rebuilt incrementally. Recommended choice id: projection_rebuild.
